groups.title: Optional tails
groups.meaning: Lower and main accumulators start from supplied tail references or null; list is empty only on null, otherwise singleton containing same dictionary. Even lower-only mode retains supplied main tail.

groups.title: Row and price normalization
groups.meaning: Iterate supplied order; convert time with native int; invoke decimal callback for open, high, low, close in that order. Access required keys directly; missing keys and conversion exceptions propagate; no sort or OHLC validation.

groups.title: New lower bucket
groups.meaning: Short-circuit null current or unequal exact integer timestamp selects allocation; store first open/high/low/close and append dictionary; no global duplicate merge.

groups.title: Existing lower bucket
groups.meaning: Mutate same lower dict: max(previous high,new high), min(previous low,new low), replace close; retain open and time. Equal extrema retain first operand representation; no quantization.

groups.title: Lower-only and aligned key
groups.meaning: Truthy lower_only skips entire main branch for this row; otherwise timeframe==1 selects raw epoch, else integer floor quotient times timeframe; no positivity guard in this helper.

groups.title: New main bucket
groups.meaning: Null current or key inequality selects new main dict with original row prices; append. Same-key consecutive aggregation only.

groups.title: Existing main and return
groups.meaning: Update high/low/close in order with previous first, retain original open/time; return pair of lower/main lists including any supplied tails.

groups.title: Batch cache ownership
groups.meaning: Bind native as_decimal and allocate local typed-value dictionary per call; no persistent price state.

groups.title: Cache lookup
groups.meaning: Key is ordered pair exact runtime type and value; lookup catches only KeyError. On miss native as_decimal returns existing Decimal (including subclass) or Decimal(str(value)); store/return; equal typed numeric values reuse first representation including exponent. Unhashable input or normalization/insertion failures propagate.

groups.title: Delegation and delta schema
groups.meaning: Delegate rows/timeframe/callback/lower_only unchanged. BucketAppend frozen slotted metadata, four integer annotations (not runtime validation). Dirty positions and settled counts separate.

groups.title: Live constructor
groups.meaning: Exact type int required before positive guard timeframe>=1; excludes bool/subclass. Set timeframe, empty lower, same list at TF1 otherwise separate list, last timestamp null, persistent cache empty.

groups.title: Append context
groups.meaning: Enter stage_append, return yielded delta only after normal context exit; context exceptions propagate.

groups.title: Empty stage
groups.meaning: Capture current lengths as dirty indexes; falsy rows yield delta and return, no state mutation; no rollback block around this yield because no published changes.

groups.title: Tail selection
groups.meaning: Convert first timestamp before iterator validation; align first key by floor division. Copy previous lower tail only with nonempty lower and equal last raw time; rewind dirty lower by one. Main tail copy/rewind only nonshared, nonempty main and same aligned key. Short-circuit guard order retained.

groups.title: Shared main and staged state
groups.meaning: At TF1 dirty main=dirty lower; capture prior time and allocate private new-price dictionary.

groups.title: Checked iterator
groups.meaning: For each row int-convert time; reject numeric inequality to original or <=0, then reject strictly decreasing relative to prior if non-null. Equality allowed; bool/numeric integer-equivalent may pass because no exact-type check here. Update captured time then yield original mapping.

groups.title: Live typed price cache
groups.meaning: Persistent typed-value membership first, return existing; else check private additions, normalize/store only if missing, return private result. No update to persistent cache yet.

groups.title: Staged aggregation
groups.meaning: Aggregate lazy checked rows, persistent-or-local normalization, copied tails and shared-main lower_only. Failure before commit leaves original suffixes and persistent cache untouched (native pure normalization assumed).

groups.title: Commit sequence before protection
groups.meaning: Snapshot old lower suffix, nonshared old main suffix or empty list, old timestamp. Add price keys, slice-assign lower list, nonshared main list, update last time in order. No catch covers these commit assignments; list identities retained.

groups.title: Protected yield rollback
groups.meaning: Try includes delta construction and consumer body; catch BaseException, restore lower and nonshared main suffixes, restore last time, delete each newly inserted price key, rethrow. No arbitrary external side-effect rollback; cleanup error can supersede original.

groups.title: Dirty and settled metadata
groups.meaning: Return dirty values as supplied, settled lower/main=max(0,length-1) independently; exclusive counts; latest bucket mutable until later key. No inferred completion across gaps.

groups.title: Candle materialization order
groups.meaning: New list; bind append, engine.Candle/classifier, local timestamp converter and format. Enumerate supplied bucket order from start_index. Timestamp uses Tehran naive local time; missing fields/constructor callbacks propagate.

groups.title: Candle fields and native color
groups.meaning: Constructor receives enumerated index, naive timestamp, formatted six date components, native tag classification with original open and close, and unchanged OHLC objects. Native Candle frozen/slotted; open<=close is GREEN including equality, else RED. Configured replacement conditional. No OHLC rounding.

groups.title: Live views identity
groups.meaning: New lists, null lower/main indexes; allocate fresh independent LiveClosedRegimes map per view instance. No shared global closed-cache.

groups.title: Suffix replacement
groups.meaning: If index present use first_dirty as given, otherwise zero. Construct candles for bucket suffix using same start index and replace list suffix before index action; no local rollback. Prefix object references retained.

groups.title: Index capacity/refresh
groups.meaning: If absent or len(candles)>index.size create fresh native index with retain_crossings true; equal capacity reuses. Otherwise invoke refresh_suffix(first), which requires 0<=first<=old_length<=new_length<=capacity, no shrinking, first==new_length no-op; clears crossing history only if first<old_length-1, replaces times/leaves/ancestors. Newly built index has empty history; failures can occur after list mutation.

groups.title: Lower update first
groups.meaning: Timed lower update receives exact retained lower list/index and lower dirty delta; assignment only after timed return. Timer/callback exceptions propagate; lower list may already be changed.

groups.title: Main alias or update
groups.meaning: TF1 aliases both main list and index to lower; else timed independent main update with main dirty index. Lower update first, no local rollback; outer protected Live wrapper discards entire views on BaseException.

groups.title: Local time cache
groups.meaning: Module-level epoch-keyed map; non-null cached object returned. Miss converts epoch to Asia/Tehran then strips tzinfo without shifting wall clock, stores and returns; no conversion failure fallback.

groups.title: Epoch cache
groups.meaning: Datetime-keyed map; non-null cached value returned including zero. Miss replaces tzinfo with Tehran (not conversion of existing aware instant), calls timestamp then int truncates toward zero, caches result. Native timezone/equality behavior retained.

groups.title: Display time cache
groups.meaning: Datetime instances/subclasses bypass display cache and delegate epoch. Otherwise use supplied key, return non-null cached value; miss exact native strptime format then epoch, store. Invalid key/date propagates.

groups.title: EngineBundle schema
groups.meaning: Frozen slotted reference record, seven fields in declared order; only primary defaults null. Optional type annotations are not runtime validators; referenced engine modules not deeply frozen.

groups.title: MarketContext schema
groups.meaning: Frozen slotted record retaining lower/main list and lower index/chronology references, visible inclusive start/end; offset zero, initial flags false by default. No deep-copy or constructor bounds validation.

groups.title: Closed-regime cache owner
groups.meaning: Fresh empty published mapping per instance. No global persistent state.

groups.title: Stage entry
groups.meaning: Capture previous map by reference; create new empty map; context manager stage does not mutate previous map merely on entry.

groups.title: Closed-prefix key
groups.meaning: Absolute exclusive end = offset+boundary. Key includes direction, offset, end, boundary candle timestamp, visible start, min(visible end,boundary-1), bullish and bearish initial flags in order. Boundary candle access before lookup; no local bounds validation. No price/time rounding.

groups.title: Cache lookup and result ownership
groups.meaning: Only end<=first_dirty_main permits previous-map lookup, equality allowed. Ineligible or missing/null invokes calculate() without arguments. Store and return same selected reference; same-stage current map not used for lookup; callback exceptions propagate.

groups.title: Publication boundary
groups.meaning: Yield resolver then assign current map only on normal resumption. Exception through yield skips publication, drops no previous map at this level; outer protected append failure discards views. Unused prior entries dropped on success.

groups.title: Index window constructor
groups.meaning: Retain supplied candles, parent times slice [start,stop), logical length stop-start. For window parent flatten base and add parent offset to start, otherwise retain parent/base and start. No local constructor validation; actual slice length and logical length can differ for invalid external arguments.

groups.title: Strict first-cross adapter
groups.meaning: Clamp left=max(left,0), right=min(right,length); empty/equal/reversed returns null before query. Otherwise translate both half-open bounds by offset, pass level unchanged, subtract offset only for non-null position (zero valid). No check of arbitrary returned position.

groups.title: Crossing delegates
groups.meaning: Select bound base first_less or first_greater respectively; native strict comparison and earliest qualifying position. Method lookup occurs before adapter executes; arbitrary configured base contract conditional.

groups.title: Range extrema adapter
groups.meaning: Reject unless chained 0<=left<right<=length (shared operands and short-circuit), no clamping. Base query with translated bounds, return exact value unchanged and local position. ValueError before query on invalid bounds.

groups.title: Extreme delegates
groups.meaning: Select bound base min or max query; native earliest-position equal-price tie; no local additional selection or arithmetic on price.

groups.title: Independent slice precondition
groups.meaning: Require nonempty existing main range 0<=start<stop<=len(main), chained short-circuit; ValueError otherwise. Does not require visible overlap.

groups.title: Lower window bounds
groups.meaning: First main timestamp inclusive; exclusive end actual next main timestamp if stop<len, else last timestamp plus chronology timeframe. Bisect_left both bounds against parent lower times; no fill of missing slots or sort.

groups.title: Slice and local record identity
groups.meaning: Create independent main/lower list slices. Copy/reindex main by enumerate if no indexed_reaction or start truthy; lower independently if no indexed_reaction or left truthy. Indexed zero-start can retain original record references; no transform other fields.

groups.title: Prepared window registration
groups.meaning: Default empty index tuple. With exact non-null indexed_reaction construct lower over parent lower_index and main over parent chronology.main_range_index; register lower then main using selected module method and sequence identity. Native registration rejects prepared.candles is not supplied sequence; no local fallback for absent main index or bad provider.

groups.title: Chronology reconstruction
groups.meaning: Use runtime type of parent chronology, with selected candle lists, integer seconds via duration.total_seconds then int, expand prepared index tuple (zero or two). Native chronology validates >=1, times from supplied indexes else builds lists, fresh per-instance confirmation/Reset/E geometry caches; configured type conditional.

groups.title: Visible/absolute mapping and trend seeds
groups.meaning: Return new context with chronology.lower_index; local start=max(0,parent visible start-start), local end=min(stop-start-1,parent visible end-start), offset adds start. No empty-visible rejection. Each explicit non-null flag overrides independently; null uses original flag and start==0, preserving short-circuit.

groups.title: Byte input boundary
groups.meaning: Timed full byte read through configured data path, remove one exact UTF-8 BOM prefix. Source-only description, no data read in audit. Read errors propagate.

groups.title: Parser precision
groups.meaning: Timed json.loads(bytes, parse_float=Decimal); integer parser default, no binary-float round trip. Native JSON errors propagate; delegate result to rows wrapper.

groups.title: Full physical context
groups.meaning: Timed identity callback returns all source rows; falsy rows raise ValueError. Presentation range never truncates physical calculation. No sort/shape repair here.

groups.title: Normalize and delegate
groups.meaning: Timed build_candle_buckets(rows,args.timeframe,lower_only=timeframe==1), unpack lower/main, delegate bucket context. Preserve alias policy later, no separate main generation at one second.

groups.title: Fresh lower view
groups.meaning: Exact null live_views selects fresh path; timed materialize lower candles, register native shared lower index without prepared parameter. Native cache keyed by id with retained sequence identity check.

groups.title: Fresh main and chronology
groups.meaning: At TF1 main aliases lower list, otherwise timed new main candles. Construct chronology with supplied lower index only; native main_range_index remains None (not independently registered here), times extracted from main records.

groups.title: Retained market context
groups.meaning: Require non-null bucket_delta via assert (not unconditional validation if asserts disabled). Update retained views, take exact list refs, register lower then main prepared indexes, construct chronology with both. Partial writes not locally caught; external native class conditional.

groups.title: Requested bucket alignment
groups.meaning: Choose main bucket sequence (lower at TF1). At TF1 from/to unchanged; otherwise floor division by timeframe then multiply. Start and end aligned independently; no sort.

groups.title: Inclusive visible range
groups.meaning: Bisect_left main bucket time for aligned start; bisect_left at aligned end+timeframe then subtract one. Exact next-bucket equality excluded, missing slots not invented. Operands are bucket epoch keys, not local datetime.

groups.title: Empty range and context return
groups.meaning: If start>=len(candles) or end<start raise ValueError, guard short-circuit. Clamp end to actual last, return MarketContext with full lists and calculated bounds; default offset/trend flags. No price conversion.

groups.title: Run scope setup
groups.meaning: Context manager captures three module timestamp caches, clears each then gets configured reaction.clear_market_indexes default None. If non-null call before entering try; exception in setup is not covered by finally.

groups.title: Run scope cleanup
groups.meaning: Yield inside try; finally call non-null clear_indexes first then clear timestamp caches in order. If configured clear raises during cleanup, subsequent cache clears are skipped; cleanup exception can supersede prior error. No blanket guarantee on arbitrary providers.

groups.title: Raw live adapter
groups.meaning: Delegate common runner with prepare-from-rows callback, singleton rows tuple and supplied progress hook; no closed resolver argument.

groups.title: Bucket live adapter fresh
groups.meaning: Collect lower/main buckets, views and delta into ordered tuple. Null views calls common runner without closed resolver.

groups.title: Bucket live adapter retained
groups.meaning: Assert delta present; enter view closed-regime stage at first_dirty_main; pass yielded resolver to common runner. Normal return exits context before result reaches caller; failure bypasses publication.

groups.title: Common live execution context
groups.meaning: Read start counter, allocate timings; enter market scope; invoke configured preparation with unpacked inputs; non-null report_stage called before prepare_pipeline_state. Call state preparation without optional live continuation; full active state rebuilt, not universal persisted trading stages.

groups.title: Response and exit
groups.meaning: Call build_response_payload with full context/state/timings/start and optional closed resolver; return through cleanup. Response/cleanup failure propagates to outer stage, no final payload delivered.

groups.title: PipelineState mutable slotted state
groups.meaning: Stores direction tuple and native result/geometry/identity/detector/zone maps by reference; required full_stopalls_by_direction is a new directional list map. primary_result and live_stages default None. No deep copy or validation at construction.

groups.title: FullDirectionState mutable record
groups.meaning: Authoritative full-range E/S and Blue/A references; invalid identities, candidates and initial S remain distinct. stopalls uses field(default_factory=list): a fresh list when omitted, not a shared default.

groups.title: E construction bounds
groups.meaning: Determine opposite through chronology and last index len(candles)-1; no local empty-input guard. Default immutable exceptions and nullable blocked/invalid sets; order_b_legs and live_scope default empty tuples.

groups.title: Geometry dispatch
groups.meaning: Closure uses supplied geometry_detectors keyed by geometry_direction. If order_geometry is not None, forwards detector plus direction/start/end/gate to callback; otherwise invokes native first_order_reaction_after_gate on selected detector. No local fallback on callback error.

groups.title: E input forwarding
groups.meaning: Pass own/opposite reactions, S list, opposite resets, chronology, inclusive 0..end_index, geometry closure, blocked Firsts, exceptions, accepted initial audit, sequence_priority, invalid S roots and B legs. Only non-null live_continuation adds both live kwargs.

groups.title: Direction preparation
groups.meaning: Resolve module references from bundle, assert E engine non-null, use market candles and chronology; opposite from reaction module. Lifecycle is dereferenced later; no separate null guard here.

groups.title: Fresh Blue/A/S sequence
groups.meaning: When shared_stages is None, time Blue then A then S. Live optional dispatch for Blue/A/S; otherwise native detector calls. S receives both reactions, opposite resets, Blue/A, full inclusive range and direction-specific initial geometry. initial_s_zones is shallow list copy.

groups.title: Shared stage reuse and accepted audit
groups.meaning: Reuse Blue/A/S detector and original initial S list reference, but copy initial S into active S and copy active S to candidates. Live hooks selected only if live exists. S-eligible A source times filter initial order audit via accepted_audit_entries; no presentation-only A acceptance.

groups.title: Initial E and S reconciliation
groups.meaning: Initial E with current B legs and live scope (feedback_index,initial). Compare lengths only. If length differs, compute removed source times with set membership; on TypeError retry with list membership. Rebuild E using valid S and blocked sources, then replace active S. Same length does not trigger replacement.

groups.title: A visibility versus dominant-stop validation
groups.meaning: Run both visibility helpers but candidate_a is not passed to split. Validate all S-eligible A against original S candidates, E, empty StopAll and candles. Parent-stop callback classifies by a_source_time attribute. A-stop confirmation uses Decimal(str(price)), trend_reactions[int(reaction_number)-1] without local index guard and direction. Stage-invalid identity set is mutable output argument.

groups.title: Invalid descendants
groups.meaning: Build exact invalid A (source_time,int source_index), project source times, select invalid S from original candidates by a_source_time; similarly stage-invalid A descendants. Only stage-invalid S removed from active S at this point, not all invalid S.

groups.title: Resolve accepted physical Order context
groups.meaning: Accepted A source times exclude invalid identities; pending A times from all candidates. Pass S audit, copied blocked First set, invalid A, pending S, opposite reactions, candles and direction; A-stop callback uses source_time not earlier confirmation. E stop event set uses tuple index 1 only for non-null parent_stop, one call per E; opposite confirmation callback and mutable exception output set.

groups.title: Final E audit
groups.meaning: Recreate detector from accepted_orders, resolved blocked Firsts, E parent exceptions, invalid S identities, B legs and live hooks; scope (feedback_index,final). Timed detection replaces E.

groups.title: Shared Order stop reconciliation
groups.meaning: Concatenate accepted_orders.values before E audit.values without local dedup. Native S reconcile; list inequality triggers exactly one rebuild, candidate identity map keyed (a_source_time,source_time), last duplicate wins and unmatched original kept. Rebuild E with same resolved inputs and shared-order scope; no loop.

groups.title: Consumed S continuation
groups.meaning: Exclude stage-invalid candidates for consumed evidence lookup. Freeze accepted A order keys. For each evidence pair, select first current E owner by int source_index and source_time equality; missing owner skips. Build continuation and replace E in sequence, so subsequent lookup uses updated list.

groups.title: Rebuild authoritative ledger and return
groups.meaning: Rebuild E audit from actual final E list and all supplemental consumed S rows in iteration order; then remove ALL invalid S identities from active S. Return E list and detector, original Blue/A, S detector, both invalid sets, filtered S, candidates and original initial S. No StopAll passed here; new field defaults fresh empty list. No local blanket exception catch.

groups.title: Feedback initialization and bounded loop
groups.meaning: Opposite direction delegated; legs empty, seen empty, shared_stages None. Pass indices 0..7. Recalculate with current B legs, live and pass index, retain first state only as shared_stages.

groups.title: StopAll donor construction
groups.meaning: Only enabled branch: collect exact (source_index,source_time) pairs from accepted E; restore roots; concatenate original E with restored rows absent from occupied set. Set not expanded during generator, no Bridge-level dedup of restored candidates. Occupied E retains original provenance.

groups.title: StopAll reconciliation
groups.meaning: Pass detector, S, donors, chronology and direction; timing lambda uses same timings, optional finder scoped feedback/pass if live non-null. Disabled path shallow-copies E and creates empty StopAll. Native returns E list and StopAll; no exception fallback.

groups.title: Restore roots and audit
groups.meaning: Both paths restore roots and ensure accepted Order audit; native ensure preserves eligible prior physical ledger entries and index. Returned E authoritative for discovery.

groups.title: Timed Order_B discovery
groups.meaning: Label direction.title; deferred lambda uses trend reactions/resets, opposite reactions, eligible A, invalid A, S, reconciled E/StopAll, detectors and priority. Optional live finder evaluated within callback.

groups.title: Convergence and publication
groups.meaning: Compare native sorted 17-field signatures, equality before seen membership. Register discovered legs, then replace current dataclass E and StopAll fields only, other references retained. Registration failure propagates.

groups.title: Cycle and exhaustion
groups.meaning: Unequal repeated new signature raises; otherwise record signature and adopt legs. Empty initial signature not preseeded. Eight unequal unseen passes cause exhaustion, no partial return.

groups.title: Requested versus required directions
groups.meaning: Both tuple bullish then bearish, otherwise singleton. Any Blue/A/S enabled requires both Reaction directions. Full context iff E non-null and S enabled, independent of lifecycle path.

groups.title: Fresh maps
groups.meaning: Ten empty maps including StopAll, no prior-run state. Annotations not price arithmetic.

groups.title: Full Reaction geometry
groups.meaning: Construct both detectors with full inclusive 0..len(candles)-1 and matching initial trend flags, no local empty guard.

groups.title: Execution, ownership, progress
groups.meaning: Native timed detect per map when live None, else live.reactions. Ownership live or native tuple element 2. Non-null progress callback after ownership before lifecycle, errors propagate.

groups.title: Independent Order geometry
groups.meaning: Capture opposite direction as lambda default for each direction, native opposite detector gate index/end/event, optional live equivalent. Independent of public ownership.

groups.title: Calculation direction and feedback
groups.meaning: Primary non-null expands to both directions else requested. StopAll gate lifecycle path non-null. Progress callback after state return before map publication.

groups.title: Publish maps
groups.meaning: Assign E, StopAll, detectors, Blue/A, invalid identities, accepted S, candidates from converged state in source order. Retain references.

groups.title: Fallback geometry
groups.meaning: Both independent A-stop finders, native Reaction for required directions even if live non-null. Native ownership third tuple element if behavior enabled; else separate empty sets. Full maps empty; primary does not independently expand fallback.

groups.title: Return PipelineState
groups.meaning: Retain requested directions, results, reuse flag, geometry, internal identities, ten maps and live reference. primary_result omitted defaults None; no serialization.

groups.title: Range record
groups.meaning: Mutable slotted dataclass with no defaults, separate S candidates/accepted S, retained references not deep copies.

groups.title: Visibility record
groups.meaning: Mutable slots; separate public lists, audit and projection parent lists. primary_groups fresh dict per instance keyword-only; projection no independent legacy rows or lifecycle feedback.

groups.title: Range prerequisites
groups.meaning: Direct requested result index, native opposite direction, market bounds. Blue prerequisite OR of exact enabled Blue/A/S flags, even if Blue display disabled.

groups.title: Blue selection
groups.meaning: Reusable required: new shallow list inclusive int(source_index) range. Otherwise required native full reactions/resets/chronology timed, no local clipping. Else empty.

groups.title: A selection
groups.meaning: A or S enabled requires A. Reusable clips full A by inclusive int source index; otherwise native A consumes selected Blue/full reactions/chronology with no local clipping; else empty.

groups.title: Reusable S
groups.meaning: Two separate empty lists initially. S enabled reusable retrieves full candidates and accepted S by reference, overrides clipped A with full eligible A reference.

groups.title: Fallback S
groups.meaning: Native S constructor uses both reaction directions, selected Blue/A, chronology, full 0..len(candles)-1, opposite resets and geometry callback. Timed detect, publish detector before eligible A read; accepted S aliases candidates. No catch.

groups.title: Range return
groups.meaning: Return current Blue/A/S references, shallow full E copy or empty; invalid sets map values or fresh empty sets. No serialization.

groups.title: Initial A visibility
groups.meaning: Native A removes occupied accepted S source indexes, then A whose candle contains S decision event; full candles supplied.

groups.title: Converged E/StopAll
groups.meaning: Shallow E and retained StopAll map copy (empty tuple default). Non-null E detector: deferred parent_stop callback S if a_source_time attribute exists else E. Otherwise deferred S.first_a_stop Decimal(str(getattr(item,price))) and decision_event_time. No local enable gate, root restore, StopAll rerun, rediscovery or registration. Non-null test differs from later E-key gate.

groups.title: Projection snapshot
groups.meaning: Three shallow lists before final visibility and range/internal filtering; item references retained, not deep immutable copies. Historical parent joins only.

groups.title: Native lineage closure
groups.meaning: Timed finalize_behavior_visibility initial A, full candidates, E/StopAll, direction, invalid S, stop callback and recorded source index/price/time candidate callback, full candles/all A. Native filters occupied source indexes, restores referenced historical S/A parents, sorts chronology, removes invalid S; returns E,S,A. No local catch.

groups.title: Primary groups
groups.meaning: After native closure before range/internal filtering: all A minus exact invalid A pairs; shallow S/E/StopAll current results. Distinct from projection and displayed arrays.

groups.title: Inclusive range
groups.meaning: Separate S,A,E,StopAll comprehensions use inclusive int source index, preserve order, no price math.

groups.title: Invalid A/S
groups.meaning: Exclude exact (source_time,int source_index) invalid pairs on clipped A and S only.

groups.title: Full audit provenance
groups.meaning: Collect source times from entire stored S detector eligible A excluding exact invalid A pairs; no range clipping. Direct S detector key access even if E absent.

groups.title: Internal Blue/behavior dispatch
groups.meaning: Flatten result map then reaction order. Native marks Blue item flags. Native filter_internal_behavior_outputs discards three reaction-context args and returns shallow lists; no secondary-Order filtering.

groups.title: Required audit IDs
groups.meaning: Post-handoff displayed S/E/StopAll only; both First/Break non-null, int conversions, native identity, set dedup.

groups.title: Audit preparation and validation
groups.meaning: E map key gate, not non-null test: prepare native audit with range, optional S detector, full eligible A sources and required IDs; else empty. Same key gate validates bridge consistency.

groups.title: Visibility return
groups.meaning: Native public Blue filters calculation-valid/noninternal; return displayed arrays, audit, projection snapshots and pre-range primary groups. No serialization or primary computation.

groups.title: Legacy Reaction/Reset
groups.meaning: Direct direction result lookup; absent/falsy bridge_output enters legacy. Timed serialize with inclusive market bounds and deferred native published_reaction_candidate(direction,item,chronology); source selection owner retains native/public pairs and does not mutate detector geometry.

groups.title: Legacy payload builder
groups.meaning: Eight arrays in fixed insertion order reactions,resets,blueLines,aZones,sZones,eZones,stopAlls,orderAudit. Blue and A exact enabled gates; Blue receives bounds; S/E/StopAll pass through visibility without new flags or clipping. Legacy E audit key presence gate (not non-null); false returns empty.

groups.title: Legacy return
groups.meaning: Return timed builder immediately; no additive selection or projector invocation. Timing label direction.title; exceptions propagate.

groups.title: Additive shared selection
groups.meaning: One transform closure; select native/public reaction pairs and reset objects once in native order; serialize with non-null selected_items bypasses re-selection even if empty. Timed returns rows and same selection; destructure selected pair.

groups.title: Additive behavior selection
groups.meaning: Enabled Blue source indexes checked by _index_selected with market bounds; enabled A uses same visibility list, disabled fresh empty; S/E/StopAll reference current visibility lists. No recalculation.

groups.title: Additive audit selection
groups.meaning: Mapping get defaults None; non-null detector sorts prepared audit by first and break main-candle epochs, stable tie order; null returns empty. Distinct from legacy key-presence gate for malformed null entries.

groups.title: Additive legacy arrays
groups.meaning: Eight arrays same key order; Blue selected list passed without explicit bounds (helper accepts when either bound None). Audit serializer called only if audit_detector non-null; native serializer sorts emitted rows by firstTime/breakTime again. No guarantee of arbitrary malformed-state equivalence.

groups.title: Additive projection and return
groups.meaning: Build bridgeOutput from same selected native/public pairs, resets and behavior/audit objects plus direction/market/state/visibility; append ninth key. Return payload via timed builder; no projector on legacy path.

groups.title: Primary order conversion helpers
groups.meaning: stamp indexes market.candles directly, then epoch candle timestamp; no range guard. value dispatch datetime first then Decimal string, otherwise unchanged (shallow value conversion, not recursive).

groups.title: Primary order identity and causes
groups.meaning: Conceptual ownerDirection argument separate from physical order.direction. Types list fixed parent-stop->Order_A then reset-leg->Order_B membership; unrecognized causes omitted from types but preserved in causes. auditCauses list of new dicts preserving source cause/key iteration; convert only immediate values.

groups.title: Primary order geometry
groups.meaning: Physical First/Break and stop source/hit local indexes retained; candle timestamps from stamp, exact event timestamps directly epoch; required fields unguarded. stopLevel str; optional boxTop/Bottom null only if is None (zero string). causes list native order.

groups.title: Primary native reconciliation
groups.meaning: Import native PL_PH functions inside call. direction absent defaults bearish; exact bullish selects lows else highs, through visible end. index_offset absent defaults zero. cycles missing/falsy fallback singleton primary; first cycle ID from first element. Native resolves physical labels, not Bridge price decisions.

groups.title: Cycle ID offset
groups.meaning: If value and offset truthy, split on colon, transform only four parts with second exactly cycle, int-convert parts 2/3 and add offset; otherwise return original. No exception guard or recursive parsing.

groups.title: Point identity
groups.meaning: Relabel order through native final_primary. origin is truthy identity_source or item. ID uses direction, origin.kind/number and absolute origin trigger/decision offsets; append transformed origin cycle only if non-null and differs from first cycle. Identity differs from rendered item label.

groups.title: Point row
groups.meaning: Render item kind/number, local indexes, epoch recorded source/event times and candle-derived trigger/decision main times, str price. Order owner bearish iff item.kind PH else bullish, physical direction unchanged. Optional current cycleId if non-null. No quantization.

groups.title: Point range gate
groups.meaning: Select in input order only inclusive source range and decision<=end; no lower decision bound or trigger bound. Point conversion after filter.

groups.title: Visible and formed cycles
groups.meaning: Visible cycle requires non-null mbl and trigger<=end, independent of source range or confirmation. MBL rows independently iterate native formed_matching_legs through end, requiring first confirmed direction-main point, not merely visible activation.

groups.title: MBL identity and cap
groups.meaning: ID uses absolute reference StopAll and second behavior indexes; row indexes local. source epoch and str price. capTime source+400 candle timestamp if index<len, else last timestamp + timeframe*(source+400+1-len); note +1 extrapolation, no visible-end cap in this procedure.

groups.title: MBL event and stop horizon
groups.meaning: Trigger/confirmation main candle timestamp and recorded exact event separate. Each stop field tests non-null stop index and <=end; future/absent stop becomes null. Optional non-null cycle ID; append in native iterator order.

groups.title: Directional physical rows
groups.meaning: Bullish highs use original highs, lows resolved; otherwise highs resolved and lows original. Main side lows for bullish else highs. Main source map exact local index plus epoch source time, later duplicate overwrites.

groups.title: Cycle memberships
groups.meaning: For each main row gather original main point cycle IDs at equal index and epoch time, decision<=end and non-null ID, transform offset then dedup by dict.fromkeys encounter order. Not based on displayed cycle list.

groups.title: Cycle summary
groups.meaning: Visible activation cycles with non-null ID; render status unchanged and MBL indexes local, trigger timestamps. highCount always len(selected(cycle.highs)); main lowIds bullish/highIds otherwise use physical map matching source and end gate, dedup encounter order. Bullish lowCount len(selected(cycle.lows)); bearish counts displayed low rows with matching transformed cycleId. Count selection actually invokes point conversion; not just count predicate.

groups.title: Post-secondary3 orders
groups.meaning: Iterate visible cycles and post_pl3_orders in encounter order; skip stop_index>end (no None guard); no source range gate. Native relabel; conceptual owner bearish if bullish else bullish, optional cycle ID. No dedup.

groups.title: Status and output schema
groups.meaning: Horizon last visible candle open + timeframe. Last visible cycle status wins even without formed MBL; otherwise qualification non-null and strictly before horizon => waiting-for-stopall-break, else waiting-for-matching-behaviors. Return primaryHighs, primaryLows, matchingBehaviorLegs, primaryStatus, primaryCycles, directional postPH3Orders bullish/postPL3Orders otherwise. Local row indexes remain for later absolute projection.

groups.title: Two direction primary groups
groups.meaning: Opposite direction from chronology; current visibility.primary_groups retained by reference; recalculate opposite range then finalize opposite visibility using current signature without args. Assign opposite groups by reference. No new independent market.

groups.title: Full owner audit preparation
groups.meaning: Fixed owner iteration bullish then bearish. Direct E/S map indexing; accepted A source time set from eligible A excluding exact (source_time,int(source_index)) invalid identities. Source times dedup even if distinct indexes. Store accepted sets; prepare full audit with 0..len(candles)-1 and assign into each aliased group.

groups.title: Native commit callback
groups.meaning: Closure uses requested direction, not iterated owner; exact bullish selects register_primary_low else register_primary_high. Register first, then rebuild only that direction's full audit using retained accepted A set. No transactional rollback.

groups.title: Primary resolver and dispatch
groups.meaning: Construct NativePrimaryOrders once, groups by reference, on_high callback and requested direction. Exact bullish selects detect_bullish else bearish; E detector direct lookup. Non-null state.live_stages dispatches live.primary instead of native detect; native uses requested S/E/StopAll groups, chronology and resolver. Current production runner does not supply live continuation.

groups.title: Final label reconciliation and visible audit
groups.meaning: Select native main-side resolution and corresponding detector label method by exact bullish. Resolve through visible end, reconcile native audit labels. Capture required physical order_identity from existing visibility audit reaction First/Break without local conversion (native helper owns coercion), set dedup. Replace only visibility.prepared_order_audit with range bounds, detectors and accepted set plus required. No local catch.

groups.title: Direction range and visibility
groups.meaning: Calculate range then finalize with new signature excluding args; unconditional before primary gate. Uses shared state/timings.

groups.title: Primary owner gate
groups.meaning: Local primary None. getattr(args,direction,both)==both picks bearish; otherwise direct args.direction. Short-circuit requested direction match, primary module non-null, E map key present, explicit lifecycle path non-null. Timed PH/PL calls requested direction. No separate S flag here.

groups.title: Primary ownership and validation
groups.meaning: Store primary in shared state before native resolve_stopall_ownership. Replace visible StopAll list only; helper chooses physical source pair of main-side primary points through end, not historical removal. Validate existing prepared audit against displayed S/E/StopAll after ownership. Failures propagate, no rollback.

groups.title: Public direction output
groups.meaning: Serialize direction after conditional primary block; primary non-null merges native primary serialization into existing payload via update. No primary rerun. If earlier stage raises, no return.

groups.title: Group regimes
groups.meaning: Group direction by first occurrence, segment order retained. Exactly one segment returns original segment object (not copy and no calculationSegments addition).

groups.title: Aggregate list arrays
groups.meaning: Multiple segments: shallow copy last mapping, union keys having any list-valued occurrence using set (key iteration not explicitly stable). Concatenate per key in segment and row order, absent key defaults empty; present incompatible iterable can fail or yield unexpected shape. No dedup/sort, row refs retained.

groups.title: Bridge aggregation
groups.meaning: Collect bridgeOutput per segment absent default empty dict; any truthy enables separate merge. dict.fromkeys keys in first encounter order; rows concatenated by segment order, missing key empty. All-falsy leaves last segment's existing key/value as copied.

groups.title: Aggregate metadata
groups.meaning: Pop calculationEndTime only from aggregate; attach grouped original segment list as calculationSegments; return direction map. Last scalar metadata retained; historical segments not mutated by merge.

groups.title: Reversal initialization and independent selectors
groups.meaning: Initial current=market, incoming=None, opposite of target (exact bullish incl absent default => bearish, otherwise bullish). indexed_reaction depends on explicit closed_regime non-null, NOT selected resolver. If live non-null use live.closed_regime even if its value None, otherwise explicit closed_regime. No fallback from live None-valued resolver to explicit one.

groups.title: Fresh local calculation
groups.meaning: Shallow copy args then replace direction. Prepare fresh local state without live keyword if continuation None, else pass live; build direction output. Return group/state. No automatic reuse of active primary state.

groups.title: Publication index conversion
groups.meaning: absolute_payload_indexes creates fresh list/dict tree even offset zero; scalars unchanged. Start metadata only if offset differs from original market offset; non-null incoming assigned after projection as singleton transition already absolute. Incoming is closure read, not a captured default.

groups.title: Stopped segment publication
groups.meaning: Stop end from current reversal main candle timestamp (not exact event). Assign calculationEndTime and reversed-to-target status, overwrite each existing cycle status, clamp each existing leg cap with min. Missing arrays default empty; no null handling. Operates on projected copies.

groups.title: Reversal loop guard
groups.meaning: Resolve optional native release once; unconditional while True. Strict 0<boundary<len(current.candles) before prefix construction; invalid raises explicit RuntimeError. Not bounded by visible start/end here.

groups.title: Closed prefix boundaries
groups.meaning: Closure default captures current/boundary/direction; market_segment [0,boundary) excludes reversal candle, indexed_reaction option. has_history records visible start<=end. If absent visible history replace bounds with whole prefix for internal proof while retaining false flag. Construction/replacement before try.

groups.title: Independent prefix calculation and release
groups.meaning: Calculate without continuation, choose highs only exact bearish else lows, resolve through prefix full last index, return offset/first timestamp/original history flag/payload/confirmed points. Finally native release if non-null else live fallback when live non-null; errors propagate. No finally for pre-try construction failures.

groups.title: Optional cache and exact Primary3 proof
groups.meaning: If selected resolve_closed non-null call with direction/current/boundary/closure; else fresh prefix. Unpack five items. Always require any confirmed point number==3 then source_time==transition.high.source_time then price==transition.level; exact equality, no tolerance/extra index condition. Failure before publish, applies cached results too.

groups.title: Hidden prefix publication
groups.meaning: If no visible history recursively replace list values with empty list without visiting elements, recurse dict values preserving keys, leave other types unchanged. Still append stopped segment after projection and status handling; retained confirmed proof not emptied.

groups.title: New regime and transition ownership
groups.meaning: Read target, serialize incoming in old context (absolute offsets already applied), slice [boundary,len(current.candles)) includes reversal candle. Two independent exact target bootstrap flags (unknown target both false), same indexed_reaction selector. Assign current direction. No state carry from closed regime.

groups.title: Active regime dispatch and cleanup
groups.meaning: Try covers optional live.active_regime then fresh local calculate with continuation. Finally native release takes precedence else live fallback. Market_segment outside try; release failure may override result/body exception.

groups.title: Next reversal or finish
groups.meaning: Read optional state.primary_result.transition default None. If None or transition.index strictly > current.end_index publish active segment with absolute offset and first candle time and break; equality repeats. Return merge of encounter-order regimes. No partial fallback.

groups.title: Response signature
groups.meaning: Optional keyword-only closed_regime defaults null; envelope return mapping. No active continuation is created here.

groups.title: Feature flags
groups.meaning: E enabled only non-null E module and exact enabled S flag; StopAll additionally requires non-null lifecycle argument. Short circuit left to right.

groups.title: Response metadata
groups.meaning: Constant engine name and module version fields; primary version uses non-null, E version uses truthiness, lifecycle version depends on argument, not stopAllEnabled. Feature flags compare exact enabled; actualFrom/To use epoch of inclusive main indices. No price conversion here.

groups.title: Direction loop
groups.meaning: Assert direction map is dict; iterate state.directions in supplied order; assign each output by direction; then read optional primary transition. Duplicate keys overwrite; no local dedup.

groups.title: Reversal gate
groups.meaning: Non-null transition and index <= end (equality included) replace all previously generated direction outputs; pass live stages and optional closed prefix resolver. No partial fallback.

groups.title: Active direction
groups.meaning: Flatten segment list (fallback singleton only when key absent), tuple (calculationStartIndex default -1, direction); max lexicographic, tie chooses lexicographically larger direction. Empty candidates default (-1,target_direction or absent default bullish); activeDirection only in reversal branch.

groups.title: T/F chronology bound
groups.meaning: Through = last visible main candle timestamp + chronology timeframe - 1 second. Repair lookup on original lower index using epoch converters and inclusive horizon. raw_timeframe absent defaults 1. Closed horizon is minimum of epoch(through)+1 and final RAW timestamp+raw interval.

groups.title: StopAll confirmation
groups.meaning: Decision epoch + requested main timeframe <= closed_through, equality confirms. Callback captures horizon; no Decimal price arithmetic.

groups.title: Segment-local T/F
groups.meaning: For every direction, annotate calculationSegments or singleton group when key absent; native T/F mutates finalized rows. Does not annotate aggregate separately. No local error catch.

groups.title: Response timings
groups.meaning: Round each recorded phase to two decimals; wall clock total ms rounded to two decimals. Return payload after annotation; timings not algorithm values.

groups.title: Market scope
groups.meaning: Clear three timestamp caches in order; get optional native clear hook, call before try; finally call same hook then clear caches. Setup failure not protected; native cleanup failure can skip later cache clears. Already covered CP293.

groups.title: Live RAW entry
groups.meaning: Delegate common runner using prepare-from-rows and singleton tuple of original rows, pass stage callback. No separate state retained. Already covered CP293.

groups.title: Live bucket entry
groups.meaning: Create tuple of both bucket lists and optional views/delta. Null views bypass closed cache. Otherwise assert delta, stage using first_dirty_main, pass resolver; context exit controls publication. Already covered CP293.

groups.title: Common live runner
groups.meaning: Start timing before scope, prepare market with unpacked inputs; optional callback after chronology; fresh pipeline state without live continuation argument; forward closed resolver only to response. Scope cleanup before return. Already covered CP293.

groups.title: CLI request validation
groups.meaning: Start total and validation clocks; emit started, parse arguments, record elapsed ms, emit completed. Exceptions propagate to module entry.

groups.title: CLI calculation
groups.meaning: Load engines before market scope; scoped market preparation, state preparation, payload; no closed resolver passed. Cleanup completes before encoding.

groups.title: CLI output
groups.meaning: Emit calculation completed; compact JSON separators comma/colon, default JSON encoder options; measure encode time separately, progress completion before print. Print payload then return zero. No local fallback.

groups.title: Module entry
groups.meaning: Only exact __main__ invokes main, raises SystemExit with returned status. Catch Exception (not BaseException/SystemExit), print default-spaced error JSON with str(exc), raise SystemExit(1). Error serialization failure propagates.

groups.title: Module imports and ownership
groups.meaning: Module docstring assigns orchestration, normalization and serialization, not trading validity; future annotations postpone evaluation; imports establish dependencies, comments no executable semantics.

groups.title: Bootstrap and shared imports
groups.meaning: Resolve own path then parents[1], sibling pipeline path, convert to string; insert at sys.path index zero only if exact string absent, do not move existing path. Flat shared imports follow bootstrap. Dynamic import failures propagate.

groups.title: Metadata and context
groups.meaning: Date format constant; public version 1.15.0, implementation 1.21.3 and modified timestamp current; extension 400; Tehran ZoneInfo and ContextVar default None. Historical version and modified literals changed only; new store nodes at 46 and 47 are current complement.

groups.title: Progress sink scope
groups.meaning: Context manager sets sink, retains token; yield without value; finally resets token including exceptional exit. Failure before try not protected. Nested scopes restore prior context, not global mutation.

groups.title: Progress envelope
groups.meaning: Create event status/label then expand details (mapping overwrite semantics); if duration non-null set durationMs rounded to two decimals, overriding any supplied detail. No price arithmetic.

groups.title: Progress delivery
groups.meaning: Get current ContextVar; only None chooses compact JSON with QG_PROGRESS prefix, stderr, flush=True; otherwise invoke sink with event. No local suppression of sink/encoding/print failures.

groups.title: Timing start and work
groups.meaning: Counter before started event, then work invoked inside try and result returned unchanged; start notification failure occurs before try and prevents work.

groups.title: Timing finalization
groups.meaning: Finally measure elapsed seconds times 1000, accumulate existing label default 0.0, emit completed even if work raised; cleanup failure can replace original exception/result. Only emitted duration rounded by emit_progress, ledger keeps elapsed numeric value.

groups.title: Module spec gate
groups.meaning: Resolve spec from supplied name/path; short-circuit spec None or loader None raises RuntimeError with path and reaction-engine wording even for other module names.

groups.title: Dynamic execution
groups.meaning: Create module from spec, assign sys.modules by spec.name before executing loader, then return module. No rollback of registered module if execution fails; existing name overwritten.

groups.title: Reaction loader
groups.meaning: Delegate load_module using fixed reaction_engine name and given path; no separate validation.

groups.title: Index selection
groups.meaning: Either bound None selects without converting index; otherwise inclusive start <= int(index) <= end; chained comparison short-circuits, no price rounding; conversion failure propagates when both bounds supplied.

groups.title: Reset selection
groups.meaning: Collect original reset objects in input order by Reset index; bounds delegated; no sorting, cloning or deduplication.

groups.title: Reaction selection
groups.meaning: Iterate input reactions, filter original First index before transform; only non-null callback invoked for accepted item; retain tuple original and public item, same reference if no transform. Return reactions and resets in encounter order.

groups.title: Selection override
groups.meaning: Non-null selected_items used directly, including empty collections; otherwise select once from result, bounds and callback. Unpack exactly two items; no re-selection on override.

groups.title: Legacy Reset serialization
groups.meaning: Produce ordered reset dictionaries with index, display epoch time, optional second time non-null guard, broken level string, fromFirstIndex. Preserve source identity values; no sort or precision quantization.

groups.title: Legacy Reaction serialization
groups.meaning: Iterate selected pairs in original order; ignore native member for public field values. Emit First, BoxTop and BoxBottom source indexes/display epochs and prices as strings, Break index/display epoch, mode. Break time unguarded, so incomplete public candidate can fail; no native mutation, no dedup. Return reactions then resets.

groups.title: Blue metadata
groups.meaning: List comprehension retains selected input order, direction/kind/reaction number/strike counts; Fibonacci level string only when non-null, otherwise null. No strike recomputation.

groups.title: Blue range and geometry
groups.meaning: Filter by getattr source_index without default; even unbounded filter evaluates attribute access first. Epoch for source/start/end, strings for source extreme and line price, optional broken level string; no validation flag or internal flag in legacy output. No clipping of line times.

groups.title: A provenance times
groups.meaning: No local filter; map caller-provided items in order. Direction and both Blue ordinals, both source/stop times converted via epoch; no optional guards.

groups.title: A continuation and trigger
groups.meaning: Stringify both Blue stop levels and continuation level, preserve continuation source and trigger indexes, convert times and exact event time separately; reaction number and first/break epochs retained.

groups.title: A source and validity
groups.meaning: Source index/time and price string; calculationValid literal true, not recomputed; optional native provenance route/event fields omitted from legacy schema. No sort, native mutation or new lifecycle validation.

groups.title: S identity and A handoff
groups.meaning: Map input items in encounter order; no filter/sort/dedup. Native direction, color, formation type and A ordinal/index retained. A source, stop and stop event timestamps converted separately with epoch; A price converted to string without rounding.

groups.title: S order identity and chronology
groups.meaning: Preserve direction, reaction number, mode, first and break indices as supplied, nullable. First, break and confirmation timestamps independently converted only when not None; absence is null, not a fallback to main time.

groups.title: S box geometry
groups.meaning: Box top/bottom converted to string only when non-null; source indices retained directly and source timestamps independently nullable. Zero Decimal not treated as absent.

groups.title: S stop and reset provenance
groups.meaning: Order stop level nullable string; source index unchanged, source time nullable epoch. Reset reaction number unchanged and reset time independently nullable; no reconstruction of missing order or reset.

groups.title: S public decision
groups.meaning: Source and decision indices retained; source and decision/main and exact event epochs independently emitted; price string; calculationValid literal true, not recomputed. All fields map native selected records.

groups.title: E identity and parent
groups.meaning: Map records in input order. Preserve direction, family, number, parent type/source/stop indices; parent price string; parent source, main stop and exact stop event epochs required, no local fallback.

groups.title: E order causes
groups.meaning: Preserve direction/reaction number/mode; construct list from native order_causes preserving iteration order and duplicates; parent-stop cause time is independently nullable; no priority logic.

groups.title: E order geometry
groups.meaning: First/break indices and epochs, confirmation epoch, box top/bottom prices and source identities/times, stop level/source identity/time are required by native schema. Price string, timestamps epoch, no optional guards on these conversions.

groups.title: E public decision
groups.meaning: Source index/time and price string, decision index/time/event epoch; no calculationValid field in this serializer. No mutation, selection, sorting, lifecycle or numbering recomputation.

groups.title: StopAll native identity and gate
groups.meaning: Keep direction/number/source and decision indices; convert source, decision, decision event and gate event times independently. Price string. Gate type and stopped behavior type/key/count are preserved, not inferred from donor. Underlying E family/number may be null.

groups.title: StopAll order causes and timing
groups.meaning: Keep optional order direction/reaction number/mode/indices; convert causes iterable to list in order, no dedup. Parent-stop cause, first/break/confirmation times independently nullable by explicit None guard.

groups.title: StopAll box and stop geometry
groups.meaning: Optional box top/bottom and order stop level string only when not None, preserving zero; source indices unchanged; source times independently nullable. Native geometry not recomputed.

groups.title: StopAll termination
groups.meaning: Stop index unchanged; stop and exact event timestamps use truthiness rather than explicit None. Absent/falsy timestamps output null, otherwise epoch. Legacy schema omits donor provenance and calculationValid; order preserved, no sorting or mutation.

groups.title: Bridge datetime type gates
groups.meaning: None returns null, string returned unchanged (including empty/invalid strings); other non-datetime values return null. No parsing or coercion.

groups.title: Bridge datetime formatting
groups.meaning: Format supplied datetime component fields year/month/day/hour/minute/second with fixed zero-padded date-time pattern. No timezone conversion, offset or microseconds in output; native Tehran-local convention expected.

groups.title: Bridge direction label
groups.meaning: Apply str then title case without validating bullish/bearish; noncanonical input is not rejected locally.

groups.title: Bridge mode mapping
groups.meaning: Convert mode to string and look up exact case-sensitive A→Leg Start or B→Normal; all other keys yield null; no fallback or case normalization.

groups.title: Bridge color label
groups.meaning: Membership in (None, empty string) gives null; otherwise str then title case; no whitelist or direction-based inversion.

groups.title: Bridge horizon
groups.meaning: Use timestamp of market.candles[end_index] plus chronology.timeframe, the exclusive end of final visible main candle. No clamp, minus-one, or lower-history bound; index/attribute/type errors propagate.

groups.title: Bridge horizon gate
groups.meaning: Return false for None without computing horizon; otherwise strict value < horizon. Equality rejected, no lower-bound check or time normalization. Comparison/index exceptions propagate.

anchor_supplement.initial_validation: 153 prior access records carried anchor-only spans; no acceptance before reconciliation.
anchor_supplement.method: Use exact current CP292 node span with matching line/column and projected node/scope identities. Preserve old evidence bytes.

method: Remote reopen of 15 review files CP293–301; verify baseline, source blob, row IDs, exact or explicitly supplemented spans, semantic group links and uniqueness. Not a second independent source semantic pass.
